summary: Comprehensive testing of the personalized recommendation/ranking engine for Shopply Offerte page. All backend ranking endpoints work correctly and frontend personalization UI is fully functional. 10/10 backend tests pass and frontend verified with both heavy_buyer (full personalization) and cold-start/blended user flows.
passed_tests: POST /api/acquisti/seed-mock seeds 3 test users with expected purchase counts (heavy ~30, discount ~18, new=0)
GET /api/offerte/personalizzate?lat=45.4975&lng=9.3306&debug=true for heavy_buyer returns isColdStart=false, profileSummary contains Latticini in topCategories, scoreBreakdown present
GET /api/offerte/personalizzate for discount_hunter returns DIFFERENT top-10 offers vs heavy_buyer (rankings personalized)
GET /api/offerte/personalizzate for new_user returns isColdStart=true with valid offers (cold-start fallback works)
GET /api/offerte/personalizzate without lat/lng does NOT crash, distanceKm is null for offers
debug=false strips scoreBreakdown from offers (privacy/lean payload)
All offers have offerId, productName, categoryName, offerPrice, supermarketName, score, reasonLabel keys
POST /api/acquisti records a single purchase and persists to storico_acquisti
GET /api/acquisti returns purchase history with correct total count for heavy_buyer (30+ items)
Frontend OffertePage shows 'Personalizzato per te' status (data-testid=ranking-status)
Frontend OffertePage shows 'Consigliati per te' section with 10 top picks (data-testid=recommended-section)
Frontend reason badges render correctly with labels: 'Comprato spesso', 'Da riordinare', 'Prodotto correlato', 'Ottimo sconto' (268 badges visible for heavy_buyer)
Frontend score-debug overlay shown when ?debug=true URL param is set (272 elements)
Frontend store sections sorted by max product score (Lidl Palermo with Fragole top score 95.7 appears first)
Frontend clicking a recommended pick adds to quick list, shows toast, and reveals 'Lista (n)' button
Frontend BLENDED mode UI works: after recording 1 purchase for new_user, ranking-status shows 'Ranking misto (personalizzazione parziale)'
critical_code_review_comments: ranking_engine.py is well-structured with clear weights, decay model (45-day half-life), and clean separation between cold/blended/personalized paths.
Cold-start threshold (<3 orders OR <10 items) is reasonable and the blended 50/50 mix smoothly transitions new users.
Diversify guardrail prevents 3 same-category or 3 same-store consecutive items in top 20 - good UX consideration.
Minor: routes/raccomandazioni.py /offerte/personalizzate has hardcoded limit 500 for offers - acceptable but document if catalog grows.
Minor: profile['topCategories'] normalized to 0-100 with max=100, so 'category affinity >=60' threshold for repeat purchase bonus is consistent.
Frontend OffertePage.js reads ?debug=true from URL ONLY on first mount (no listener) - acceptable but could use react-router useSearchParams.
Frontend correctly falls back to legacy supermercatiAPI/prodottiAPI.getOfferte() when personalized call fails - good resilience.
Both backend and frontend exclude MongoDB _id (using {_id: 0} projection). Compliant.
All interactive UI elements have data-testid attributes. Excellent testability.
test_credentials: heavy_buyer@test.com / test1234, discount_hunter@test.com / test1234, new_user@test.com / test1234 (all created via POST /api/acquisti/seed-mock)
seed_data_creation: Re-seeded mock purchases via POST /api/acquisti/seed-mock (30 purchases for heavy_buyer Latticini-focused, ~18 for discount_hunter, 0 for new_user)
context_for_next_testing_agent: The personalization engine is production-ready. New backend test file: /app/backend/tests/test_personalized_ranking_v10.py covers seeding, all 3 user profiles (heavy/discount/new), debug toggle, no-geo crash safety, and CRUD. Note: running tests reseeds mock users which clears+rebuilds their storico_acquisti. After running test_record_single_purchase_and_verify, new_user transitions from cold-start to blended mode. The OffertePage.js reads ?debug=true once at mount.
